name: warp-control-center
description: Cloudflare WARP 代理的 Node.js 重写版 —— 替换 seiry/cloudflare-warp-proxy，原生 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理（去除 socat 双跳），warp-svc 进程守护，实时监控面板。极低占用。

scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --filter ./mini-services/warp-proxy dev" "cd dashboard && bun run dev"
scripts.build: cd dashboard && bun install && bun run build
scripts.install:all: bun install --filter ./mini-services/warp-proxy && cd dashboard && bun install

author: Inkcoo <admin@inkcoo.com>
